title: Agent Admission Issue — payload
description: The gate authority's offer of the bilateral relationship credential: both gate results, the closed-lexicon verdict, the derived tier grant, the ledger head, and the first-signed credential. The agent's counter-signature in the response completes it.

agent.description: VID of the admitted agent. MUST equal the document recipient.

gates.description: Exactly two gate results of distinct kinds: one supervisorApproval, one understandingChallenge. Two results of the same kind never satisfy the two-gate rule.

ledgerHead.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the audit-ledger head at issuance; every evidenceDigest must resolve into the chain it names.

credential.description: The first-signed W3C Verifiable Credential expressing the admission relationship. Completed by the agent's counter-signature; exactly two proofs, two roles, two distinct parties.

credentialDigest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the completed, counter-signed credential.

counterSigned.description: The agent's acceptance; the credential is not in force without it.
